excluded_attempts.reason: One new implementation test helper incorrectly multiplied all source scan calls by progressive row visits after a buffered parity run on the same source. Buffered scans increment scans but not progressive visits. Relative counter baselines and the expected total scan count were corrected; no runtime or value golden changed. All nine initial independent extrema tests and prior aggregate targets passed.

review: The buffered extrema state extraction adds no tick, evaluation, comparator, allocation or publication step; existing pre-loop policy stability proof and retained candidate replay remain in the original order.

Progressive resolver-dependent String candidates retain owned cells until checked EOF and receive both final actual policy and completion before comparison. Numeric/non-String and no-resolver selection preserve the original one-cell strict algorithm.

AggregateResult retains CellValue, and metered full-node identity lookup precedes retained Min/Max dispatch. Unknown aggregate declaration, raw bytes, Error data and policy/completion survive until their actual consumers.
State/result vectors charge their actual enlarged types; existing generated Count(*) under8KiB and previous Count/Sum/Avg resource controls pass without weakened limits.

Independent controls cover required/unknown policies, late completed reverse comparison, EOF-before-provider/sink, raw/Error consumers, ExtendedDate, GUID/Binary singleton and multirow refusal parity, signed zero, equal representations, mixed Single/Double exact comparisons, cancellation and all cumulative quotas.
Old unsupported Min/Max progressive controls now use still-unsupported First/Last; no grouping/named/subquery/domain/volatile admission was broadened.

Native/CLI controls cover Jet4/ACE2007/ACE16 synthetic profiles, no complete snapshot publication, checked EOF before output, malformed selected fields before filters, retained raw/Error observers, explicit ordinal Text policies, linked target reuse and completed UNION batch prefixes.
minimum_profile: tablecraft-query --lib --no-default-features compiles independently of concrete adapters and application hosts.
stream_phase_boundary: WHERE and syntactic aggregate operands run once per qualifying row in written order. Resolver String selection follows checked EOF; all states finish before final projection and strict scalar publication. These explicit phases can differ from buffered load-before-evaluation error priority and do not qualify native ordering.

independent_replay.qualification: Independent original getter/exact model evidence; no native Access evaluation claim.
